Do not reteach or model target answers before the initial record. Read exact words and scribe without correction. Record content prompts. After all initial checks, give one feedback point and record a separate response or retry. Missing evidence is not a wrong answer.

Supported: Read the same task words without suggesting an answer. Allow pointing, an aid or exact scribing. If choices are reduced, a step is prompted or a question is supplied, record that content support. Keep the first response before any help.

My skills and next step: assessing lesson
Year A · Identity & Belonging · 14–18 December 2026 · 40 minutes

Use familiar tasks from Weeks 2–4 and review actual evidence from Weeks 1–6. Do not model answers, rehearse matches or teach a new skill first. Read the exact instruction; accept speech, pointing, drawing, writing or an aid. Record mode and help. Exact reading or scribing is access support; a suggested answer, supplied question, step cue or reduced options is content support. Keep all first responses.

A–3: a shop helper helps a shopper find a tin. B–1: a garden helper waters pots. Task 2 is spare. Both matches and one relevant reason are required. A reason can be selected or spoken; record choice support.

First one circle in the tray; then one square next to it. Observe order and final set. A final set alone does not prove the order. The spare square is not used. Note any cue and whether a change was self-initiated.

Present: Put the circle card in a tray. Wait for a question about which tray. Accept an equivalent question, gesture or aid selection. Fixed adult reply: Use tray 2. Observe one circle in tray 2. If no question occurs, record this before any prompt or feedback. A guessed correct tray does not prove clarification.
Use the actual work code and date. Record skill, clue from the work, job task and reason. Check whose work it is and what help was used. A shared team product needs an individual contribution record.

After the first record, give one specific point. Keep the learner’s reply or changed action separately, with support and date. Record a practical next step, help and intended review date. No copied model is independent evidence.

Observation: use private parallel sets only where an adult can see each turn. Within the ten-minute task block, queue short individual turns. If staffing or time prevents observation, mark not observed and arrange a dated check. Never infer success from another learner or a finished group tray.
Learner code __________  Review date __________  Staff role __________
For each week, record the actual work reference, date, individual contribution and help. Mark present, partial, missing or not observed. Do not backdate new work or infer success from attendance.

For each criterion use: shown without content prompt; shown with content support; not yet shown; or not observed. Record access support separately. A reduced task cannot establish the full criterion. No total score or qualification threshold is inferred.
